answer: Because the timing is written down against the lotus challenge, the nebula audit can replay the quill history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 20 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 5 epochs. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
